create_task_instance: create a Task instance with default throttling tick and NeverCondition stop condition
step_task: step a Task with an agent to check its stop condition and mark finished
add_child_task: add a child task to the agent's task stack with an optional shared stop condition
interrupt_task: interrupt a Task by setting its interrupted flag to True
adjust_task_throttling: hurry up or slow down a Task's throttling tick within configured upper and lower limits
